verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּ֭תְהַלֵּל בְּי֣וֹם מָחָ֑ר כִּ֤י לֹא־ תֵ֝דַ֗ע מַה־ יֵּ֥לֶד יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·hal·lêl bə·yō·wm mā·ḥār kî lō- ṯê·ḏa‘ mah- yê·leḏ yō·wm
verses.literal: Do not boast about tomorrow . . . for you do not know what a day may bring

verses.original: יְהַלֶּלְךָ֣ זָ֣ר וְלֹא־ פִ֑יךָ נָ֝כְרִ֗י וְאַל־ שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hal·lel·ḵā zār wə·lō- p̄î·ḵā nā·ḵə·rî wə·’al- śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Let another praise you and not your own mouth a stranger and not your own lips

verses.original: כֹּֽבֶד־ אֶ֭בֶן וְנֵ֣טֶל הַח֑וֹל וְכַ֥עַס אֱ֝וִ֗יל כָּבֵ֥ד מִשְּׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kō·ḇeḏ- ’e·ḇen wə·nê·ṭel ha·ḥō·wl wə·ḵa·‘as ’ĕ·wîl kā·ḇêḏ miš·šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: A stone is heavy and sand is a burden but aggravation from a fool outweighs them both

verses.original: אַכְזְרִיּ֣וּת חֵ֭מָה וְשֶׁ֣טֶף אָ֑ף וּמִ֥י יַ֝עֲמֹד לִפְנֵ֥י קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ·zə·rî·yūṯ ḥê·māh wə·še·ṭep̄ ’āp̄ ū·mî ya·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê qin·’āh
verses.literal: Wrath is cruel and anger is like a flood but who can withstand . . . jealousy

verses.original: ט֭וֹבָה תּוֹכַ֣חַת מְגֻלָּ֑ה מֵֽאַהֲבָ֥ה מְסֻתָּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·ḇå̄h tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ mə·ḡul·lāh mê·’a·hă·ḇāh mə·sut·tā·reṯ
verses.literal: Better an open rebuke than love that is concealed

verses.original: נֶ֭אֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵ֣י אוֹהֵ֑ב וְ֝נַעְתָּר֗וֹת נְשִׁיק֥וֹת שׂוֹנֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm piṣ·‘ê ’ō·w·hêḇ wə·na‘·tā·rō·wṯ nə·šî·qō·wṯ śō·w·nê
verses.literal: The wounds of a friend are faithful but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׂ֭בֵעָה תָּב֣וּס נֹ֑פֶת וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָ֗ה כָּל־ מַ֥ר מָתֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš śə·b̲ē·ʿāh tā·ḇūs nō·p̄eṯ wə·ne·p̄eš rə·‘ê·ḇāh kāl- mar mā·ṯō·wq
verses.literal: The soul that is full loathes honey but to a hungry soul any bitter thing is sweet

verses.original: כְּ֭צִפּוֹר נוֹדֶ֣דֶת מִן־ קִנָּ֑הּ כֵּֽן־ אִ֝֗ישׁ נוֹדֵ֥ד מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṣip·pō·wr nō·w·ḏe·ḏeṯ min- qin·nāh kên- ’îš nō·w·ḏêḏ mim·mə·qō·w·mōw
verses.literal: Like a bird that strays from its nest is a man who wanders from his home

verses.original: שֶׁ֣מֶן וּ֭קְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּֽח־ לֵ֑ב וּמֶ֥תֶק רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ מֵֽעֲצַת־ נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: še·men ū·qə·ṭō·reṯ yə·śam·maḥ- lêḇ ū·me·ṯeq rê·‘ê·hū mê·‘ă·ṣaṯ- nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Oil and incense bring joy to the heart and the counsel of a friend is sweetness to the soul

verses.original: רֵֽעֲךָ֨ וְרֵעֶה אָבִ֡יךָ אַֽל־ תַּעֲזֹ֗ב וּבֵ֥ית אָחִ֗יךָ אַל־ תָּ֭בוֹא בְּי֣וֹם אֵידֶ֑ךָ ט֥וֹב שָׁכֵ֥ן קָ֝ר֗וֹב מֵאָ֥ח רָחֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: rê·‘ă·ḵā wə·rē·ʿɛh ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’al- ta·‘ă·zōḇ ū·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ’al- tā·ḇō·w bə·yō·wm ’ê·ḏe·ḵā ṭō·wḇ šā·ḵên qā·rō·wḇ mê·’āḥ rā·ḥō·wq
verses.literal: Do not forsake your friend or your father’s friend and do not go to your brother’s house in the day of your calamity better a neighbor nearby than a brother far away

verses.original: חֲכַ֣ם בְּ֭נִי וְשַׂמַּ֣ח לִבִּ֑י וְאָשִׁ֖יבָה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḵam bə·nî wə·śam·maḥ lib·bî wə·’ā·šî·ḇāh ḥō·rə·p̄î ḏā·ḇār
verses.literal: Be wise my son and bring joy to my heart so that I can answer . . . him who taunts me

verses.original: עָר֤וּם רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה נִסְתָּ֑ר פְּ֝תָאיִ֗ם עָבְר֥וּ נֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rūm rā·’āh rā·‘āh nis·tār pə·ṯā·yim ‘ā·ḇə·rū ne·‘ĕ·nā·šū
verses.literal: The prudent see danger and take cover but the simple keep going and pay the penalty

verses.original: קַח־ בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־ עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נָכְרִיָּ֣ה חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ- biḡ·ḏōw kî- ‘ā·raḇ zār ū·ḇə·‘aḏ nā·ḵə·rî·yāh ḥaḇ·lê·hū
verses.literal: Take the garment of him who posts security for a stranger get collateral if it is for a foreigner

verses.original: מְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ רֵעֵ֨הוּ׀ בְּק֣וֹל גָּ֭דוֹל בַּבֹּ֣קֶר הַשְׁכֵּ֑ים קְ֝לָלָ֗ה תֵּחָ֥שֶׁב לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḇā·rêḵ rê·‘ê·hū bə·qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl bab·bō·qer haš·kêm qə·lā·lāh tê·ḥā·šeḇ lōw
verses.literal: If one blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning it will be counted to him as a curse

verses.original: דֶּ֣לֶף ט֭וֹרֵד בְּי֣וֹם סַגְרִ֑יר וְאֵ֥שֶׁת מְדוֹנִים נִשְׁתָּוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: de·lep̄ ṭō·w·rêḏ bə·yō·wm saḡ·rîr wə·’ê·šeṯ mə·ḏō·nīm niš·tā·wāh
verses.literal: A constant dripping on a rainy day and a contentious woman are alike

verses.original: צֹפְנֶ֥יהָ צָֽפַן־ ר֑וּחַ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן יְמִינ֣וֹ יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ṣō·p̄ə·ne·hā ṣā·p̄an- rū·aḥ wə·še·men yə·mî·nōw yiq·rā
verses.literal: restraining her is like holding back the wind or grasping oil with one’s right hand

verses.original: בַּרְזֶ֣ל בְּבַרְזֶ֣ל יָ֑חַד וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ יַ֣חַד פְּנֵֽי־ רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bar·zel bə·ḇar·zel yā·ḥaḏ wə·’îš ya·ḥaḏ pə·nê- rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: As iron sharpens iron so one man sharpens . . . another

verses.original: נֹצֵ֣ר תְּ֭אֵנָה יֹאכַ֣ל פִּרְיָ֑הּ וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣יו יְכֻבָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ṣêr tə·’ê·nāh yō·ḵal pir·yāh wə·šō·mêr ’ă·ḏō·nāw yə·ḵub·bāḏ
verses.literal: Whoever tends a fig tree will eat its fruit and he who looks after his master will be honored

verses.original: כַּ֭מַּיִם הַפָּנִ֣ים לַפָּנִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן לֵֽב־ הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kam·ma·yim hap·pā·nîm lap·pā·nîm kên lêḇ- hā·’ā·ḏām lā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: As water reflects the face . . . so the heart reflects the true man . . .

verses.original: שְׁא֣וֹל וַאֲבַדֹּה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה וְעֵינֵ֥י הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּֽעְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ō·wl wa·ʾă·ḇad·dōh lō ṯiś·ba‘·nāh wə·‘ê·nê hā·’ā·ḏām lō ṯiś·ba‘·nāh
verses.literal: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied so the eyes of man are never satisfied

verses.original: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ לְפִ֣י מַהֲלָלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: maṣ·rêp̄ lak·ke·sep̄ wə·ḵūr laz·zā·hāḇ wə·’îš lə·p̄î ma·hă·lā·lōw
verses.literal: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold but a man is tested by the praise accorded him

verses.original: אִ֥ם תִּכְתּֽוֹשׁ־ אֶת־ הָאֱוִ֨יל׀ בַּֽמַּכְתֵּ֡שׁ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָ֭רִיפוֹת בַּֽעֱלִ֑י לֹא־ תָס֥וּר מֵ֝עָלָ֗יו אִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’im tiḵ·tō·wōš- ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·wîl bam·maḵ·têš bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·rî·p̄ō·wṯ ba·‘ĕ·lî lō- ṯā·sūr mê·‘ā·lāw ’iw·wal·tōw
verses.literal: Though you grind a fool like grain with mortar and a pestle yet his folly will not depart from him

verses.original: יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּ֭דַע פְּנֵ֣י צֹאנֶ֑ךָ שִׁ֥ית לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַעֲדָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏō·a‘ tê·ḏa‘ pə·nê ṣō·ne·ḵā šîṯ lib·bə·ḵā la·‘ă·ḏā·rîm
verses.literal: Be sure to know . . . the state of your flocks and pay close attention . . . to your herds

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לְעוֹלָ֣ם חֹ֑סֶן וְאִם־ נֵ֝֗זֶר לְד֣וֹר דּוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥō·sen wə·’im- nê·zer lə·ḏō·wr dōr
verses.literal: for riches are not forever nor does a crown endure to every generation

verses.original: גָּלָ֣ה חָ֭צִיר וְנִרְאָה־ דֶ֑שֶׁא וְ֝נֶאֶסְפ֗וּ עִשְּׂב֥וֹת הָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gā·lāh ḥā·ṣîr wə·nir·’āh- ḏe·še wə·ne·’es·p̄ū ‘iś·śə·ḇō·wṯ hā·rîm
verses.literal: When hay is removed and new growth appears and the grass from the hills is gathered

verses.original: כְּבָשִׂ֥ים לִלְבוּשֶׁ֑ךָ וּמְחִ֥יר שָׂ֝דֶ֗ה עַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḇā·śîm lil·ḇū·še·ḵā ū·mə·ḥîr śā·d̲eh ‘at·tū·ḏîm
verses.literal: the lambs will provide you with clothing and the goats with the price of a field

verses.original: וְדֵ֤י׀ חֲלֵ֬ב עִזִּ֗ים לְֽ֭לַחְמְךָ לְלֶ֣חֶם בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏê ḥă·lêḇ ‘iz·zîm lə·laḥ·mə·ḵā lə·le·ḥem bê·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḥay·yîm lə·na·‘ă·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will have plenty of goats’ milk to feed you food for your household and nourishment for your maidservants
